questions.questionText: A solid wooden cube of side 3 cm is painted red on all outer surfaces and then sliced into identical 1 cm smaller cubes (27 cubes in total). How many smaller cubes have exactly THREE faces painted red?
questions.hint: Recall formulas: 3-face = 8 (corners), 2-face = 12(n-2), 1-face = 6(n-2)², 0-face = (n-2)³.
questions.explanation: Cubes with three painted faces are located strictly at the 8 vertices (corners) of the cube. Regardless of the size of the cube (as long as n ≥ 2), there are always exactly 8 corner cubes.
solutionSteps: Step 1: Identify problem archetype (painted cube formula or rotational dice rule).
Step 2: Apply the governing geometric formula.
Step 3: Result is 8.
questions.memoryTip: Painted Cubes: Corner = 8, Edge = 12(n-2), Face center = 6(n-2)², Core = (n-2)³.

questions.questionText: In a standard unbiased playing die, which number is on the face opposite to the face showing number 2?
questions.hint: In a standard die, opposite faces sum to 7. In two-position dice, rotate clockwise from the common face.
questions.explanation: By definition, in a standard die, the sum of opposite faces is always equal to 7. Therefore, the face opposite to 2 is 7 - 2 = 5.
solutionSteps: Step 1: Identify problem archetype (painted cube formula or rotational dice rule).
Step 2: Apply the governing geometric formula.
Step 3: Result is 5.
questions.memoryTip: Painted Cubes: Corner = 8, Edge = 12(n-2), Face center = 6(n-2)², Core = (n-2)³.

questions.questionText:
Two positions of a single die are shown:
Position 1: Faces 3, 1, and 2 are visible.
Position 2: Faces 3, 5, and 6 are visible.
Which number is on the face opposite to 1?

questions.explanation: Keeping the common face (3) as the anchor and rotating clockwise in both positions: Position 1 gives 3 -> 1 -> 2. Position 2 gives 3 -> 5 -> 6. Comparing corresponding positions, 1 is opposite to 5, and 2 is opposite to 6.

Step 2: Apply the governing geometric formula.
Step 3: Result is 5.
questions.memoryTip: Painted Cubes: Corner = 8, Edge = 12(n-2), Face center = 6(n-2)², Core = (n-2)³.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 6 cm is painted green on all surfaces and sliced into 1 cm smaller cubes. How many smaller cubes have NO face painted (completely unpainted)?
questions.hint: Recall formulas: 3-face = 8 (corners), 2-face = 12(n-2), 1-face = 6(n-2)², 0-face = (n-2)³.

questions.explanation: By definition, in a standard die, the sum of opposite faces is always equal to 7. Therefore, the face opposite to 2 is 7 - 2 = 5.
solutionSteps: Step 1: Identify problem archetype (painted cube formula or rotational dice rule).
Step 2: Apply the governing geometric formula.
Step 3: Result is 5.
questions.memoryTip: Painted Cubes: Corner = 8, Edge = 12(n-2), Face center = 6(n-2)², Core = (n-2)³.

questions.explanation: By definition, in a standard die, the sum of opposite faces is always equal to 7. Therefore, the face opposite to 2 is 7 - 2 = 5.
solutionSteps: Step 1: Identify problem archetype (painted cube formula or rotational dice rule).
Step 2: Apply the governing geometric formula.
Step 3: Result is 5.
questions.memoryTip: Painted Cubes: Corner = 8, Edge = 12(n-2), Face center = 6(n-2)², Core = (n-2)³.

questions.questionText:
Two positions of a single die are shown:
Position 1: Faces 3, 1, and 2 are visible.
Position 2: Faces 3, 5, and 6 are visible.
Which number is on the face opposite to 1?
questions.hint: In a standard die, opposite faces sum to 7. In two-position dice, rotate clockwise from the common face.
questions.explanation: Keeping the common face (3) as the anchor and rotating clockwise in both positions: Position 1 gives 3 -> 1 -> 2. Position 2 gives 3 -> 5 -> 6. Comparing corresponding positions, 1 is opposite to 5, and 2 is opposite to 6.
solutionSteps: Step 1: Identify problem archetype (painted cube formula or rotational dice rule).
Step 2: Apply the governing geometric formula.
Step 3: Result is 5.
questions.memoryTip: Painted Cubes: Corner = 8, Edge = 12(n-2), Face center = 6(n-2)², Core = (n-2)³.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 6 cm is painted green on all surfaces and sliced into 1 cm smaller cubes. How many smaller cubes have NO face painted (completely unpainted)?
questions.hint: Recall formulas: 3-face = 8 (corners), 2-face = 12(n-2), 1-face = 6(n-2)², 0-face = (n-2)³.
questions.explanation: Unpainted cubes form the inner core of the cube after peeling off the outer layer. Formula = (n - 2)³ = (4)³ = 64.

Step 2: Apply the governing geometric formula.
Step 3: Result is 64.

questions.explanation: By definition, in a standard die, the sum of opposite faces is always equal to 7. Therefore, the face opposite to 2 is 7 - 2 = 5.
solutionSteps: Step 1: Identify problem archetype (painted cube formula or rotational dice rule).
Step 2: Apply the governing geometric formula.
Step 3: Result is 5.
questions.memoryTip: Painted Cubes: Corner = 8, Edge = 12(n-2), Face center = 6(n-2)², Core = (n-2)³.

questions.questionText:

Step 2: Apply the governing geometric formula.

questions.memoryTip: Painted Cubes: Corner = 8, Edge = 12(n-2), Face center = 6(n-2)², Core = (n-2)³.

questions.questionText: A cube of side 5 cm is painted blue on all faces and cut into 1 cm unit cubes. How many smaller cubes have exactly ONE face painted?
questions.hint: Recall formulas: 3-face = 8 (corners), 2-face = 12(n-2), 1-face = 6(n-2)², 0-face = (n-2)³.
questions.explanation: Cubes with one painted face are situated at the center of the 6 outer square faces. Formula = 6 × (n - 2)² = 6 × (3)² = 54.

Step 2: Apply the governing geometric formula.
Step 3: Result is 54.
